scripts.format: prettier --write src server scripts docs *.json *.ts *.html README.md
scripts.build:android:web: tsc -b && vite build --mode android --base ./ --outDir dist-android && node scripts/prepare-android-assets.mjs
scripts.android:release: npm run build:android:web && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleRelease lintRelease
scripts.android:debug: npm run build:android:web && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
